programmes.title: Education & Learning
programmes.description: Supporting access to education, learning resources, awareness and educational opportunities for children, youth, women and communities.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting access to education and learning opportunities for all.
possibleActivities: Scholarships or assistance where lawfully permitted and resources are available

programmes.title: Women's Education & Empowerment
programmes.description: Creating pathways for women and girls to access learning, skills, awareness and opportunities for greater social and economic participation.
programmes.shortDescription: Creating pathways for women and girls to access learning and opportunities.

programmes.title: Skills for the Future
programmes.description: Helping people build practical skills that can improve employability, livelihood opportunities and confidence.
programmes.shortDescription: Helping people build practical skills for employability and livelihood.

programmes.title: Employment & Livelihood
programmes.description: Connecting training and opportunity by supporting employability, career guidance, placement facilitation and livelihood development.
programmes.shortDescription: Connecting training and opportunity through employability and placement support.

programmes.title: Corporate & Institutional Partnerships
programmes.description: Companies, industries, corporate entities, institutions and other lawful organisations can partner with the Foundation to design and implement socially beneficial projects focused on employment, skills, training, livelihood and community development.
programmes.shortDescription: Partnering with companies and institutions for socially beneficial projects.
programmes.importantNote: Project receipts and programme income are applied towards the Foundation's charitable objectives and are not intended for private profit distribution.

programmes.title: Food, Care & Human Dignity
programmes.description: Supporting people facing difficult circumstances through responsible humanitarian and community-support initiatives, subject to available resources and applicable requirements.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting people facing difficult circumstances with dignity.
programmes.visualDirection: Show people receiving support respectfully. Avoid images that humiliate beneficiaries.

programmes.title: Shelter, Rest & Community Support
programmes.description: Supporting or developing facilities and programmes that provide safe, dignified and useful spaces for people who need temporary or long-term support.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting safe, dignified spaces for people in need.

programmes.title: Care With Dignity
programmes.description: Working toward programmes and facilities that support elderly people with dignity, companionship, care and access to essential support.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting elderly people with dignity, companionship and care.

programmes.title: Health Awareness & Community Wellbeing
programmes.description: Promoting health awareness and preventive community wellbeing through educational and outreach programmes.
programmes.shortDescription: Promoting health awareness and preventive community wellbeing.
programmes.importantNote: Do not claim medical treatment or professional clinical services unless the Foundation is actually authorised and appropriately staffed.

programmes.title: Stronger Villages, Stronger Communities
programmes.description: Supporting practical development initiatives that strengthen communities, improve awareness and create opportunities for local people.
programmes.shortDescription: Strengthening communities through practical development initiatives.

programmes.title: Responding When Communities Need Support
programmes.description: Supporting lawful relief and rehabilitation initiatives during disasters and emergencies, subject to resources, permissions and operational capacity.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting relief and rehabilitation during disasters and emergencies.

programmes.title: Protecting the Environment Around Us
programmes.description: Encouraging environmental responsibility through community participation, awareness and practical local initiatives.
programmes.shortDescription: Encouraging environmental responsibility through community participation.

programmes.title: Compassion Beyond People
programmes.description: Supporting responsible animal welfare and community initiatives that promote humane treatment, care and awareness.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting responsible animal welfare and community initiatives.

programmes.title: Gau Seva & Animal Care
programmes.description: Supporting responsible cattle-care and Gau Shala-related charitable initiatives with an emphasis on animal welfare, cleanliness, nutrition and humane care.
programmes.shortDescription: Supporting responsible cattle-care and Gau Shala initiatives.
programmes.importantNote: Avoid presenting religious activity as the only purpose of the organisation. The website should position this within the broader charitable and animal-welfare mission.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Listen to communities and identify genuine needs.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Develop practical programmes, projects and partnerships.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: Work with trained people, volunteers, institutions and partners.

steps.title: Measure
steps.description: Track outputs and outcomes using records and verifiable information.

steps.title: Improve
steps.description: Learn from implementation and continuously strengthen programmes.
